title: Vue: Disable controls for events and exposed by default
body:
## What I did

For events and exposes it does not really make sense to show controls since it is not used.
They will be disabled by default now.

The behaviour was already implemented but it didn't work due to a typo.

comments.body: We still require storybook controls for slots. Indeed, it does not cover all cases, not due to Vue's capabilities, but because we do not yet have the compatible type of control.  Currently, we have a basic one, but adding this feature involves intervention and opinions from other team members. We had plan me and @kasperpeulen to collaborate on this in future releases.

comments.author: larsrickert
comments.body: Makes sense :) I changed it to only disable controls for events and exposes
